title: ETHOBOT CAT100 Orientation
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting ethobot cat100 orientation to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Bring a draft of your own to the tutor instead of asking it to generate from scratch.
Record each tutor suggestion as accepted, modified, or rejected with a one-line reason.
Keep rejected suggestions in the log so the trail shows what you turned down.
Use the tutor to sharpen claims without letting it invent facts or inflate them.
